inspiration: Recolour by lookup, not by art: sprites store one grey base, and a hue table (1024 rows of 16 columns in the shader) supplies the colour. Our version could use our own palette-swap sheet so one base sprite gives armour and monster variants.

One shader, many draw modes: a mode number switches the same shader between plain, hued, partial hue, land, spectral, shadow, lights, effect hue and gump drawing. Our version could keep that idea with our own mode set, so world, UI and effects share one pipeline.
Shadow and light as their own modes: shadows and light glows are separate modes, not extra sprites. Our version could draw shadows as a flat-shaded mode and lights as an additive mode.
One light direction for the whole iso world: a single fixed vector lights every sprite the same way. Pick one key-light vector for our world so the lighting stays consistent.
Ghost look as a named mode: a spectral mode in the shader gives translucent spirits. Our version could use our own ghost tint, a dissolve or scanline edge, and an edge glow, not the stock blue.
Pixel-art upscaling in the shader: an edge-aware 2x scaler keeps pixel art crisp at higher resolution. Our version could use our own edge rules, palette-aware, with an optional sharpen step.
Fonts by role: a regular face, a bold face and six map-label faces. Our version could keep few faces, each with one role, using our own pixel face.
Windows as resource tables: each window's images and strings live in a resource table, not in code. Our version could keep a data table per window with art references.

briefs.label: Hue-swap sprite recolour
briefs.why: One grey base sprite plus a lookup strip gives many colour variants without extra art.
briefs.keep: A palette-strip lookup chosen by a hue index; a per-draw hue value; shader modes that change the sample path.
briefs.change: Our own strip layout, not the 16-column grid; separate ramps for metal and cloth; normal-driven shading on the ramp.

briefs.label: Spectral ghost mode
briefs.why: A named mode makes spirits read as ghosts at a glance.
briefs.keep: A dedicated shader mode; translucency; its own branch in the shader.
briefs.change: Our own ghost tint, not the stock blue; a scanline or noise dissolve at the edges; a faint edge glow.

briefs.label: Pixel-art 2x upscaler
briefs.why: An edge-aware 2x scale keeps pixel art crisp instead of blurry.
briefs.keep: Edge tests on colour differences; a fixed 2x factor; per-pixel blend choices.
briefs.change: Our own edge rules, not a copy of any published set; palette-aware edges; an optional sharpen pass.

briefs.label: Font set by role
briefs.why: Separate faces for body text, bold titles and map labels keep UI readable at small sizes.
briefs.keep: A few faces, each with one role; bold reserved for titles.
briefs.change: Our own pixel face, not the stock face; a different size ladder.
